description: This file defines a fragment class 'ShowcaseFragment' used to display an interactive tutorial overlay over an Android activity. It manages a sequence of steps, each highlighting a specific view and showing instructions, with functionality for navigation, highlighting, and user callbacks.

classes.name: ShowcaseFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a help overlay with a sequence of highlight steps.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the adapter when the fragment attaches to context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and sets up the view hierarchy, including ViewPager and its adapters.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Prepares display metrics and initiates the first step.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up highlights and runs finish callbacks.

methods.name: setScroller
methods.description: Sets the ScrollView used for scrolling to highlighted views.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the sequence.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step in the sequence.

methods.name: executeStep
methods.description: Executes UI updates for the specified step, including scrolling and highlighting.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Removes the fragment from the activity.

methods.name: highlightView
methods.description: Highlights a specific view with a background and elevation.

methods.name: setOnFinish
methods.description: Sets a callback to run when the overlay is dismissed.
